title: [spec-gap][R-X509-047][divergent] X.509 anchor store rejects non-Ed25519 CA keys; profile allows SHA-256-class CA algorithms
description: spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md section 7: the CA key is not the node identity key and NEED NOT be Ed25519; signature algorithm may be e.g. ecdsa-with-SHA256/SHA384 or RSASSA-PSS; only the subject SPKI is constrained. Divergent: the only X.509-accepting code, python/src/lichen/crypto/trust_anchors.py:104-105 (pubkey_from_der_cert), raises unless the cert subject key is Ed25519PublicKey, so a conforming ECDSA CA certificate cannot be stored as an x509 anchor. Secondary notes: the store does not check keyUsage keyCertSign on CA certs (profile preamble describes ordinary RFC 5280 CAs as basicConstraints CA=TRUE + keyCertSign), and its docstring cites stale bead viku.6 (no longer exists). Classification: divergent, low confidence on intended scope. Question: keep the lichen anchor store Ed25519-only and document x5chain chain validation (chain-validation bead) as the only path for non-Ed25519 CAs, or relax pubkey_from_der_cert for x509-kind anchors? Needs a decision before bedw.8 consumers land. Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/crypto/trust_anchors.py + python/tests/coap/test_trust_anchors_resource.py.
